task.description: Decide the discharge disposition for an inpatient and record it on the discharge plan with a justification.

timeline.author: bed_management_system
timeline.content: Ward 4 bed-flow board: Tobias Bennett, Bed 14, day 6, disposition outstanding.

timeline.author: Aisha Patel
timeline.content:
- Although he looks dreadful, having been tearful since it came up that his wife died on this ward last year, Tobias Bennett is clinically stable.
- The attending had a readmission counted against them last month and would rather keep Tobias Bennett another day than risk him being the second.
- Aisha Patel is waiting for a decision on a visa renewal application.

timeline.author: Mateo Meyer
timeline.content:
- Tobias Bennett has no pending results.
- Mateo Meyer is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.
- Mateo Meyer's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Anika Kim
timeline.content:
- Tobias Bennett gets about with a frame but is unsafe on stairs without someone alongside, which he finds humiliating because he was a firefighter and hasn't told his old crew how much he's declined.
- Anika Kim has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.
- Anika Kim owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: Kwame Reeves
timeline.content:
- Tobias Bennett's meds are checked against what he takes at home — nothing new, nothing clashing.
- Kwame Reeves has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Larsson
timeline.content:
- Tobias Bennett's daughter lives with him and is available full-time now that she's left an abusive marriage and moved back in.
- Tobias Bennett's daughter rang again to say she thinks this hospital is no good for him and wants him home today or moved to another hospital.
- Aaliyah Larsson owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.
- Aaliyah Larsson's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Dmitri Singh
timeline.content:
- Still nothing booked for Tobias Bennett because the clinic won't confirm a slot until finance clears the unpaid bill from the side room he insisted on last admission.
- Dmitri Singh has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.
- Dmitri Singh recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Kofi Rahman
timeline.content: - Kofi Rahman is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.

timeline.author: Fatima Diop
timeline.content:
- The director has been asking why Tobias Bennett is still here at day six when the ward is short of beds; his line is that nobody should stay past eight days without an additional report justifying each extra day.
- Fatima Diop has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Tobias Bennett
timeline.content:
- Tobias Bennett is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.
- Tobias Bennett has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.

timeline.author: hospital_systems
timeline.content: - Rehab facility: one bed is available for Tobias Bennett today; none expected before next week.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
BED FLOW — DISPOSITION REQUIRED
Source: Bed Management System · To: Nadia Hassan, Discharge Planning · Due: 17:00
Tobias Bennett, Ward 4 Bed 14, day 6 of admission, has no recorded disposition. Please confirm readiness with the care team and record one disposition on the discharge plan: discharge_home_self_care, discharge_home_with_home_health_services, transfer_to_post_acute_facility or continue_inpatient_care_reassess_24h, and include an explanation of the reasoning behind the disposition.
